summary: Strong E2.3 calendar lesson. Static-date trap (can't count forward) is a real grade-1 misconception with concrete recovery (touch-and-count, number-line strip). Worksheet Part 1 deliberately varies practice with 'next Friday' to verify navigation transfer. Materials are everyday (wall calendar, chart paper, paper mat). Cal anchors hook and consolidation but lacks a distinctive quotable refrain (Level-3 voice). Math authenticity high: calendar treated as navigable structure with rows=weeks/columns=days made explicit.
